newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Governments must help mobilise oil capital - analyst.
newsitem.headline: Governments must help mobilise oil capital - analyst.

text.p: Governments of oil-producing and consuming countries must help to ensure the mobilisation of sufficient capital expenditure for research and development in order to guarantee oil supplies, a French analyst said on Tuesday.

Daniel Champlon, director of the information division of the Institut Francais du Petrole, told an oil conference in Nicosia, "To perpetuate the diversity of supplies and to maintain a sufficient renewal rate of reserves at reasonable costs, efforts carried out in high quality upstream research and development must be continued."
Short-term requirements of the industry and increasing difficulties in mobilising capital expenditure required for research and development must be addressed, he added.

"The only way to solve these problems will be with the participation of industry, independent research centres, public or private, but also governments, whether they are producer states or consumer states," Champlon said.
Oil companies prefer to concentrate their activities in known, mature and low risk areas. But, he said, the exploration of new provinces or little-known basins should not be neglected.
"It may still prove to be very profitable. The efforts made in Colombia and the discoveries of Cusiana and Cupiagua are a good illustration of it."
"A better understanding of sedimentary basins will lead to the optimisation of production while also making production possible from small accumulations," he said.
